title: Pictograms / Expressive application — Automation collateral

location.series: IBM Design Language / alternate tab states
location.label: Expressive

slide_intent: Coordinate a bold graphic with supporting explanation, because expressive imagery works best when it directs attention to a clear proposition.
strategic_value: The gradient-path motif and supporting symbols can connect IBM’s automation message to its pictogram vocabulary.
demonstration: The displayed collateral excerpt pairs an automation headline at upper left with broad blue-cyan paths and black circular nodes at upper right; text and three smaller benefit symbols sit below.
practical_value: Compare the hero motif’s prominence with the supporting symbols before deciding how much expressive detail a communication needs.

content_islands.name: Headline and hero motif
content_islands.spec: Place the Robotic Process Automation label, headline and supporting line at left, balanced by thick gradient paths and circular nodes at right.

content_islands.name: Supporting content
content_islands.spec: Below, divide a text column from three smaller symbol-and-caption groups; preserve the source excerpt’s lower crop.

reference_purposes.Expression: The blue-cyan paths, black nodes and smaller line symbols demonstrate the expressive vocabulary in a marketing layout.
reference_purposes.Application: The source shows an IBM Robotic Process Automation collateral example pairing the graphic with a specific message.
reference_purposes.Constraint: The accompanying usage text says expressive pictograms should be used selectively and sparingly where strong graphic presence is needed.
